i18n/operands#

The operands CLDR plural rules ask about a number (n, i, v, w, f, t, e).

Version: v1.0.0

Description#

The operands CLDR plural rules ask about a number (n, i, v, w, f, t, e). PluralNumber provides them; generated locale data reads them.

Public API#

role PluralOperands#

role PluralOperands

Internal exact CLDR rule boundary. Compiled data consumes only this role.

PluralOperands.relation#

relation(name is string, modulus is int, minimum is int, maximum is int) is bool

Whether operand name, modulo modulus when not 0, lies in minimum..maximum.
